A standalone rational checker independently replays 9,963 product comparisons from package paths; finite tests corroborate the universal algebra, not replace it.

value.rationale: Four is a sharp, naturally motivated first ordering-sensitive calendar horizon in a latent–infectious model. The exact positive pairing law completely orders all four-distinct-season schedules without numerical Floquet products and yields two opposite invasion verdicts under an identical seasonal multiset. This directly distinguishes scheduling from mean exposure at disease-free stability and is more substantive than a single textbook spectral calculation.
